# Synthetic PlantUML blocks for test/node_view/plantuml_test.dart (#283).
# Made up for the tests; not taken from any real note. Each top-level
# heading is one case; the tests read the text under it.

* Sequence
#+begin_src plantuml
@startuml
actor User
participant "Web App" as W
database Store as S
User -> W : open page
W -> S : query
S --> W : rows
W --> User : render list
@enduml
#+end_src

After the sequence.

* State
#+begin_src plantuml
@startuml
[*] --> Idle
Idle --> Running : start
Running --> Idle : stop
Running --> [*] : fail
@enduml
#+end_src
